Manage notebooks

Usage:
  kernel notebook [command]

Available Commands:
  close       Close a notebook
  create      Create a notebook
  list        List all notebooks
  open        Open a notebook
  random-icon Randomly set notebook icon(s) from built-in emojis
  remove      Remove a notebook
  rename      Rename a notebook
  set-icon    Set a notebook icon

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for notebook

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            dry run mode: validate and print what would happen without making changes
  -f, --format string      output format: table | json (default "table")
  -v, --log-level string   log level: off | trace | debug | info | warn | error | fatal (defaults to conf.json system.logLevel)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace path

Use "kernel notebook [command] --help" for more information about a command.
